nodes.title: Starting PostgreSQL
nodes.body: PostgreSQL must be running before tests can execute. Use Docker to start a PostgreSQL instance: ```bash # Check if postgres container is already running docker ps --filter name=storj_unit_tests_postgres --format '{{.Names}}' # If not running, start it: docker run --rm -d -p 5433:5432 --name storj_unit_tests_postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=tmppass postgres:17 # Wait for postgres to be ready (retry until successful) until docker exec storj_unit_tests_postgres psql -h localhost -U postgres -d postgres -c "select 1" > /dev/null 2>&1; do

nodes.title: Running Tests
nodes.body: 1. **If test name is provided in arguments**: - Find the package containing the test using Grep - Run the test with PostgreSQL configured 2. **If only package path is provided**: - Run all tests in that package with PostgreSQL configured 3. **Command format**: ```bash go test -v ./package/path -run TestName -postgres-test-db 'postgres://postgres:tmppass@localhost:5433/teststorj?sslmode=disable' ``` 4. **Report test results**: - Show whether tests passed or failed - List all subtests that ran - If tests failed, offer to help investigate the failures

nodes.title: Cleanup
nodes.body: To stop the PostgreSQL container when done: ```bash docker rm -f storj_unit_tests_postgres ```
